title: Move the Block
tagline: "Move the Block" is an introductory breakout game that serves as an excellent tool for understanding the implementation of on-chain games using Lattice and ReactJS.
description: "Move the Block" is an introductory breakout game that serves as an excellent tool for understanding the implementation of on-chain games using Lattice and ReactJS. As part of our mission to foster a vibrant developer community, we are excited to announce the launch of the "Move the Block" community. This community aims to provide valuable resources such as tutorials and videos that empower aspiring developers to create their own on-chain games using Lattice, Mud, and other cutting-edge technologies.
how_its_made:
The game "Move the Block" is built using a combination of Lattice and ReactJS, two powerful technologies that enable the creation of on-chain games.

To build "Move the Block," the game mechanics typically involve the following steps:

Game Initialization,
User Interaction,
Ball Physics,
Game Logic,
Game Loop,
Integration with Lattice.
